steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

attacks.name: Full Auto
steps: |!wild| |*Elemental Blast|: After this attack is resolved, for each |!wild| in the attack roll, the defender gains 1 of the following special conditions: |§bleed§Bleed|, |§shock§Shock|, |§slow§Slow|, or |§stun§Stun|.

superPowers.name: Winging It (Affiliation: Guardians of the Galaxy)
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, choose up to 3 allied characters. Each chosen character gains 1 |<winging_it>Winging It| token. While a character with a Winging It token is attacking, defending, or dodging, it may spend a Winging It token during the |*Modify Dice| step to reroll up to 2 of its dice. At the end of the Round, remove all Winging It tokens from characters.

superPowers.name: Hit and Run
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes an attack action followed by a move action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Plucky Attitude
superPowers.body: When attacking, if this character rolled no |!hit|, it may reroll all of its current attack dice. When defending, if this character rolled no |!block|, it may reroll all of its current defense dice.

Stamina increased from 5 to 6 on the Injured side.
